facts.fact: The national statistical information council's session of 7 April 2026 recalled that the 2026 annual budget plan of FCFA 31.5bn (12.8bn domestic, 18.2bn external) funds the main 2026 actions, including the fourth General Population and Housing Census (RGPH); Cameroon Tribune reports this.

note: Surveys ECAM 6, MICS 7 and EESI4 are listed as 2026 funded actions with no results stated, so no survey fact; text is paywalled and cut off.
